description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a unique opportunity to join a facility dedicated to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.
The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a proven track record in facility management, regulatory compliance, and team development. You will be instrumental in upholding the highest standards of quality care, operational efficiency, and financial performance. This role offers a competitive salary package for a professional committed to making a significant impact.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated expertise in healthcare regulations, compliance, and quality assurance.
Strong financial acumen and experience with budget management.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
An urgent Full-time Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) opportunity is available in Rockledge, FL, at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This role offers a competitive hourly rate and includes a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

As an SLP, you will be instrumental in assessing, diagnosing, and treating communication and swallowing disorders, helping patients achieve their highest potential for recovery and improved quality of life. Join a dedicated team committed to patient-centered care in a supportive environment.
requirements: Current and valid Florida SLP license
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA or eligibility
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00 per hour, plus a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
Join our dynamic team as a Team Leader in Orlando, FL. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for guiding and motivating a team to achieve operational excellence and deliver outstanding results. We are seeking a proactive leader who can foster a collaborative and productive work environment.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact within a leading service center. You will play a key role in team development, performance management, and ensuring the smooth execution of daily operations. If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for leadership, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience in a team leadership or supervisory role
Ability to motivate and develop team members
Proficiency in operational processes and performance management
